evidence.summary: CASI describes the Air Force Shijiazhuang Flight Academy as one of the PLA Air Force’s three flight academies, organised like an operational air unit and under the Central Theater Command Air Force, which trains fighter and ground-attack pilots who have graduated from the Air Force Aviation University.
The academy comes under the Central Theater Command Air Force.
